tool.name: TideCluster - Annotate Genome
tool.description: Annotate tandem repeats in genome assembly using similarity-based approach

param.name: ref_seq
param.label: Reference sequence
param.help: FASTA file to be annotated by TRC library

param.name: fasta_file
param.label: Tandem repeat library
param.help: The 'Library of tandem repeats' output of a TideCluster run, which TAREAN writes with headers in RepeatMasker format ('>TRC_1#Satellite'). Any other library works as long as it has that form; a plain FASTA whose headers lack the '#' part does not - this tool reads the classification out of every header and stops with an IndexError if one is missing.

tool.help: This is a tool for reannotating tandem repeats using a similarity-based approach. This tool runs RepeatMasker using the tandem repeat library generated by TAREAN in TideCluster. Resulting RepeatMasker output is processed to retain only high-quality tandem repeat hits. Overlapping tandem repeat annotation are merged, and regions shorter than twice the monomer length are excluded from the output. Reannotate tandem repeats using similarity-based approach can fill in gaps in annotation provided by TideCluster/TideHunter.
